response.label: complementary
response.rationale: The predicates 'owned_by' and 'wearing' describe different relationships between entities and items. 'owned_by' indicates possession, while 'wearing' indicates an item is being worn by an entity. These relationships represent distinct properties of an object and its associated item. The 'wearing' predicate describes a state (an item being worn), while 'owned_by' describes a relationship of ownership. The action context for 'SNOW' demonstrates that 'wearing' is an effect of placing an item on an entity, while 'owned_by' is a static relationship. The two predicates are complementary because they describe different aspects of the same situation.
